title: Reranker quantization validation: metric gates, calibration audit, and rollback strategy
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define and execute an end-to-end validation workflow for reranker quantization (FP8 and INT8). Deliver a reproducible calibration audit, pass/fail metric gates for NDCG/MRR, and an automated rollback strategy for production rollouts.
background: Recent offline experiments show FP8 and asymmetric INT8 can reduce serving cost but sometimes cause subtle rank-order regressions at tail queries. We need a robust, reproducible validation pipeline and clear gates so Dedicated/Hosted rollouts don't regress customer ranking quality.
goal: Ship a validated calibration + evaluation runbook and CI gating automation that prevents model variant promotion if NDCG@10 or MRR@10 drop beyond defined thresholds. Provide an operator-facing rollback playbook and monitoring dashboards.
scope: Calibration sweep artifacts and deterministic calibration seed management for FP8/INT8
Automated compute of NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR@10 on canonical reranker evaluation sets
Metric gate thresholds and statistical test (paired bootstrap) to decide promotion
Integration with our staging evaluation runner and will-call GitHub Actions gating job
Operator rollback/runbook for live traffic incidents
out_of_scope: Feature changes to reranker model architecture
Full production A/B experiment launch (this ticket provides gating; experiments separate)
Quantization kernel development (handled by runtime team)
success_metrics: No promoted quantized reranker causes >0.5% relative NDCG@10 regression undetected for 90 days
Gating job reduces false promotions to <2% across monthly releases
Rollback actions restore baseline latency and NDCG within 5 minutes in >95% of incident cases
acceptance_criteria: Calibration audit notebook that replays calibration steps and outputs deterministic per-layer scale tables
Gating Action configured: runs on PR and on release branch; fails if NDCG@10 delta (quantized vs fp32) < -0.5% with p<0.05
End-to-end test that simulates a degraded quantized build and verifies rollback playbook triggers in staging
Dashboard tile in Console showing baseline vs candidate NDCG/MRR and CI of deltas
plan_steps: 1) Define canonical reranker eval sets (head/tail, freshness buckets) and freeze splits - Aisha
2) Implement deterministic calibration run: seed control, dataset subsampling, and per-layer histogram outputs - Liam
3) Produce calibration artifacts for FP8 and two INT8 symmetric/asymmetric variants - Eng subteam
4) Run batch evaluation runner (staging infra) and compute NDCG@1/3/10, MRR@10 with paired bootstrap CI - Data Eng
5) Implement GitHub Actions gating job using evaluation runner and attach status to PRs - SRE
6) Build console dashboard and alert rule for post-promotion monitoring - Console team
7) Draft rollback playbook: feature-flag fallback, model-pin, and emergency capacity switch - Oncall/Infra
8) Conduct 2 dry-run promotions in staging and one controlled promotion in dedicated with monitoring - Release Lead
risks: Calibration non-determinism across GPUs leads to noisy CI failures
Thresholds too strict block beneficial quantized models and increase cost
Statistical tests not well-powered for tail buckets, causing undetected regressions
Automated rollback may not fully restore KV cache state and could impact latency
mitigations: Pin RNG seeds and hardware config in calibration job and record env fingerprint
Provide per-bucket thresholds (head vs tail) and require manual signoff for tail-only regressions
Use paired bootstrap with 1k resamples and report CI bands per-bucket
Rollback playbook includes cache warmup step and gradual traffic switch with canary windows

testing_plan: Unit tests for calibration utility to assert deterministic scale table output
Integration test: run gating job on known-good fp32 and a synthetic degraded quantized artifact - expect fail
Staging end-to-end: promote quantized candidate behind feature flag, run live traffic canary for 30m
Chaos test: simulate GPU OOM during calibration and assert proper failure and cleanup
rollout_plan: Canary: 5% traffic for 1 hour with automated NDCG/MRR checks
Expand: 25% for 2 hours if metrics within threshold
Rollback: instant model-pin to previous hashed model and drain candidate nodes, then warm baseline caches
